The relative positions and proportions of these architectural and furniture elements should remain consistent between views.
Style: Bearridge Minimal Flat
Description: Minimalist 2D flat illustration style with simplified geometric forms and a restrained, muted color palette. Characters, objects and environments are constructed from large clean color shapes with very limited internal detail. No visible decorative outlines, no realistic textures, no gradients and no photorealistic rendering. Human anatomy and facial features are intentionally simplified while preserving clear silhouettes and recognizable proportions. Clothing is represented with broad flat shapes and only a few simplified folds. Environments use simplified geometry and reduced architectural detail. The overall image should feel graphic, clean, restrained and cinematic.
Lighting: Simplified graphic lighting using large flat areas of light and shadow. Shadows are broad, hard-edged and minimally detailed rather than physically realistic. Avoid complex light gradients, soft volumetric illumination, glossy reflections, bloom and detailed ambient lighting. Lighting should primarily support composition, silhouettes and separation of forms while preserving the flat illustrated appearance.
Palette: Restrained muted color palette dominated by dark desaturated blue, teal, charcoal, muted gray, olive and warm brown tones. Skin tones and occasional warm highlights may provide controlled contrast. Use solid flat colors with a limited number of distinct tones per object. Avoid highly saturated colors, colorful gradients and excessive color variation.
Line: Shape-driven illustration with little to no visible contour linework. Forms should be defined primarily by adjacent flat color areas and silhouettes rather than outlines. Avoid thin decorative lines, sketch lines, comic-style ink outlines and excessive internal line detail.
Anatomy: Simplified but believable human anatomy with natural adult proportions. Bodies should remain clearly readable through strong silhouettes and large geometric shapes. Reduce anatomical detail while preserving correct limb placement, posture and overall proportions. Avoid exaggerated cartoon anatomy and photorealistic anatomical detail.
Faces: Facial features are strongly simplified and graphic. Characters have no visible eyes: do not draw eyeballs, irises, pupils, eye whites, eyelashes, or detailed eye shapes. The eye area is represented only through simplified facial geometry, brow shapes, shadow shapes, or may be omitted entirely. Preserve character identity through face shape, hairstyle, eyebrows, nose, mouth, facial hair, glasses, and other distinctive features. No realistic skin texture or detailed facial rendering.
Shading: Minimal flat shading. Use a small number of large, hard-edged shadow shapes rather than smooth tonal transitions. Shadows may simplify or merge details into broad dark areas. No gradients, soft airbrushed shading, ambient occlusion, complex reflections or realistic material rendering.
Backgrounds: Simplified graphic environments built from large geometric shapes and broad areas of flat color. Preserve important architecture, spatial layout, furniture placement and scene readability while removing unnecessary decorative detail and texture. Backgrounds should use the same visual abstraction as the characters and should never become photorealistic.
Camera: Cinematic but restrained composition using believable perspective and clear staging. Allow wide shots, medium shots, close-ups and varied viewing angles as required by the scene. Prioritize readable silhouettes and composition. Avoid exaggerated wide-angle distortion, fisheye effects, extreme perspective and unnecessary depth-of-field effects.
Negative rules: No photorealism. No 3D-rendered appearance. No realistic textures. No gradients. No glossy materials. No painterly brushwork. No sketch lines. No detailed comic-book outlines. No visible eyes, eyeballs, pupils, irises, eye whites, eyelashes, or realistic eye details. No detailed facial rendering. No detailed fabric texture. No complex reflections. No bloom. No volumetric lighting. No photographic depth of field. No excessive small details. Do not introduce visual detail absent from the established minimalist flat style.
